data.title: Descartes acquires Extensiv, adding AI tech to fulfillment solutions
data.description: It marks Descartes' second acquisition in two weeks of AI-powered fulfillment companies.

data.title: David's Bridal touts 99.78% approval rate after anti-fraud solution rollout
data.description: It achieved a 99.78% approval rate within the first two weeks of launch. That has improved authorization performance while reducing unnecessary friction for legitimate guests, according to the retailer.

data.title: Ecommerce Trends: Which AI sources are sending referral traffic to online retailers?
data.description: AI referral traffic keeps growing for top online retailers, and new rankings reveal which large language models (LLMs) are sending the most visitors to those ecommerce sites, with ChatGPT and Claude both seeings shifts.

data.title: Dr. Squatch drives revenue through post-purchase tracking page adjustments
data.description: Tracking pages are often high-traffic touchpoints, and the brand wanted to capitalize on that. It wanted consumers to have estimated delivery dates both pre- and post-purchase, but it struggled with visibility into how its third-party logistics (3PL) providers operated.
